I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket **#4092**.

That comes from Ilse Varga's message in #north-random on Oct 13, which said the ticket was still open. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could have seen it herself. My reply also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

Dana also sent me a private guess about this ticket in a direct message and asked me to keep it to myself. I left it out of the channel reply.
